snippet.title: Oddbat Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
Have you ever wondered how vampires attain immortality? Join this vampire who transforms into a bat to overcome all the challenges that arise, in order to perform a ritual unlike any other!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158280/Oddbat/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
